articles.title: MBS Losing it All? Trump No Help as Houthis Hit Riyadh's Tallest Tower & Saudi GDP Crashes | Vantage
articles.description: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is facing another setback. Yemen's Houthis have managed to hit the tallest tower in Riyadh, which is the office of the Public Investment Fund. This comes just days after a Houthi missile damaged the Aramco building in Riyadh. MBS met with CENTCOM chief Brad Cooper, but the US is yet to commit to fighting the Houthis directly. Firstpost looks at everything that has been going wrong for MBS in 2026. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the situation that Saudi Arabia finds itself in as the fighting in Yemen and tensions in West Asia escalate. HKS also examines how MBS has been reaching out to Mecca Pact members Turkey and Pakistan, alongside his attempts to get help from US President Donald Trump. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
